original_release_evidence.observed: G02202 Version 4, DOI 10.7265/efmz-2t65, retired status and requirement to cite the data including the subset used where applicable.
The guide requires citation, identifies the source DOI and asks users to indicate the subset used and access date.

Version 4 and Dataset_DOI 10.7265/efmz-2t65. Access_Constraints reports retirement and unavailability. Use_Constraints reports retirement and unavailability for use and directs citation of prior or planned use.
